sources.entry: FontVibe - AI text effect generator with 100+ styles (neon, glitch, 3D bold, Viking, cyberpunk, and more). Outputs high-resolution PNG with optional transparent background.

summary.name: FontVibe
summary.one_liner: FontVibe is a web-based AI font generator that turns text into finished text-effect artwork (neon, glitch, fire, 3D and more) exported as PNG or JPG images rather than installable font files.
use_cases: Make a YouTube thumbnail or title card
Design a shop sign or poster
Create a can or product label
Produce neon, glitch or fire text artwork
summary.what_it_does: FontVibe generates finished text artwork from a one-sentence brief or a chosen style. It proposes three design directions per request, and you pick one to get a finished image; you can then send notes to rework that piece. It offers 399 AI fonts across 138 styles, with lighting, texture and background generated along with the lettering. Outputs are JPEG or PNG at 1K to 4K resolution, with optional transparent PNG export and a Vibe Edit tool that can split layers into separate transparent PNGs. The page also includes a separate copy-and-paste Unicode fancy text generator.
notable: Describe a job in a sentence and get three AI design directions to choose from
Outputs images (PNG/JPG), not installable .ttf or .otf font files
Transparent PNG export and layer splitting in Vibe Edit
Commercial use allowed on all plans including free, no account needed to start
caveats: Free accounts render up to 2K; higher resolutions (3K, 4K) need paid plans
Paid plans: one-time credit packs from $3.99; monthly subscriptions from $9.99
Each image takes about 20-40 seconds to render
